condition: User explicitly confirms customers with purchases in 2024, residence country Brazil
submitted_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM public.customer c JOIN public.invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' AND c.country = 'Brazil';
validated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM public.customer AS c JOIN public.invoice AS i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.country = 'Brazil'
